text: Completed the run-local-axis closure slice. Explicit EmptyCellPolicy values now apply within run partitions: typed EmptyCellScope audits retain RetainZero as NonEstimable, lower Omit to RunColumnDisposition.Omitted, and return DesignError.EmptyFactorCellInRun for Reject during model construction; legacy UseDropEmptyFlag keeps its historical behavior. fit.run-local-axes.v1 now executes selected-row censor gaps in both mixed-TR runs, compares complete/chunked fixed-effects results, and keeps the independent projected small-matrix oracle. Completion audit also fixed a silent hypothesis hazard: fixed-effects alignment now rejects absent nonzero T, F, and response-functional structural components by ColumnId instead of dropping their weights. Evidence: designJVM/test 200/200, designJS/test 200/200, model JVM+JS 24/24 each, fitJVM/test 188/188, fitJS/test 180/180; focused T/F/response plus scenario 11/11 each platform; manifest 27 entries valid; git diff --check clean; type-discipline review clean for this slice.
